description: Zone di pianificazione per rischio vulcanico dell'area Flegrea (RNDT Dataset) - Versione 2.0 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dati.protezionecivile.it. On the basis of the pre-eruttive and eruptive scenarios contained in the Final Report of the Working Group responsible for defining the reference scenario for the Flegrei Fields emergency plan for volcanic risk, the two hazardous areas (red and yellow) of the National Emergency Plan for the Flegree area, for which different operational measures are ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Flegrea Area Volcanic Risk Planning Zones (RNDT Dataset) — Version 2.0" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include DGR n.175 3 aprile 2015, DGR n.669 23 dicembre 2014, DGR Zona Rossa Campi Flegrei, zona Rossa Campi Flegrei, Direttiva Campi Flegrei 24 giugno 2016, DGR Zona Gialla Campi Flegrei. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
